state:
Goal `core-time-and-1-more`: `Core\Time::at`, `fromEpoch`, `fromIso`, `parse` and `sleep` have all their feature proofs — `about.md`, three examples, one attack, one bench with a recorded figure, a Rust test with its `covers:` marker — and `Core\Time` has its class card (`TIME_CARD` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs`). `bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\Time'` now names only `now` and `monotonic`.
The `parse` attack found two bugs, both fixed with a `.nvst` case (`tests/conformance/core/time-parse-names-the-range-and-refuses-a-field-too-wide-to-hold.nvst`): a field repeated past 18 letters overflowed `i64` in `crate::cldr::number` (a panic under debug, a wrapped year under release), and a time past the timestamp range threw jiff's sentence. Both now throw a plain `ParseError` sentence, the range one in the words `at` and `fromIso` use.
After those two, `Core\Time\Date` is the stage's other check: its class card is missing, and `minus`, `with` and `compareTo` owe examples, an attack, a bench and `.nvst` cases.

next.title: the dossier, the last `Core\Time` members, then `Core\Time\Date`
next.note: one file set: `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs` (the `TIME` and `DATE` rows, their cards and `mod tests`), `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs`, plus each member's own proof directories.

items.text: **`Core\Time::now`** — owes examples, hostile, perf and a Rust test with `// covers: Core\Time::now` (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). Row near `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs:2128` in the `TIME` class; the body is beside `nvs_core_time_monotonic` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs:3517`. Output is not fixed, so examples print what can be checked (an order, a difference), the way `docs/examples/core/Time/sleep/02-a-wait-of-zero-or-less.nvs` does.
**`Core\Time::monotonic`** — owes the same. Body at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs:3517`. `slept` in `mod tests` is the shape for a Rust test that times a call.

**`Core\Time\Date`'s class card** — add its `ClassDoc` above the class's `CLASS` row near `DATE_NAME` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs:2429`, and delete `Core\Time\Date` from `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs:5283` (`rule:core-api/reference-card`). `TIME_CARD` is the shape.

next.after: Then the `Core\Time\Date` members, each owing examples, hostile, perf and `.nvst` cases with a `// covers:` marker (an instance member is not credited by a call): `minus` (row `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs:2506`, body `:4673`, one case), `with` (row `:2515`, body `:4685`, two cases), `compareTo` (row `:2524`, body `:4716`, two cases).

backlog: A program under the root `nvs.toml` that calls `Core\Time::sleep` also runs queued jobs from that file's queue, and printed `the queued job scripts/receipt.nvs was not run` to stderr during `docs/examples/core/Time/sleep/01-wait-longer-before-each-retry.nvs`. Stdout was clean. Not checked whether a plain `nvs run` is meant to drain the queue (`crates/nvs-cli/src/worker.rs`).

`crate::cldr`'s `S` field with more than nine letters reads every digit and throws `fraction out of range` for a long fraction, where the first nine digits would do (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/cldr.rs`, `Field::Fraction`).
